name: Vowsmith
tagline: The CRM built for the people who actually run the wedding.
positioning: Vowsmith is the client and booking system for solo and small-team wedding vendors — photographers, florists, planners, and DJs who wear every hat.

hero.h1: Every inquiry, contract, and payment in one honest place.
hero.sub: Vowsmith replaces the spreadsheet, the inbox, and the sticky notes. Track leads from first message to final gallery — without hiring an ops person you can't afford yet.

features.title: Inquiry-to-booking pipeline
features.description: Watch every couple move from 'just checking your date' to signed contract. See exactly which leads went cold and follow up before they book someone else.

features.title: Contracts and deposits together
features.description: Send a proposal, e-sign the contract, and collect the retainer in one link. No more chasing a signature and an invoice in two separate tools.

features.title: Wedding-day timelines
features.description: Build the shot list, load-in schedule, and vendor contacts for each event. Share a clean day-of timeline the whole team reads from.

features.title: Payment reminders on autopilot
features.description: Balance due 30 days out? Vowsmith nudges the couple so you don't have to send the awkward money email yourself.

features.title: Seasonal booking calendar
features.description: See which Saturdays in peak season are still open. Block travel days and turnaround time so you never double-book a busy weekend.

features.title: Client portal couples actually use
features.description: One tidy page where couples fill out questionnaires, approve galleries, and pay — no login gymnastics, no lost email threads.

testimonials.quote: I booked 40 weddings last year out of a spare bedroom. Vowsmith is the only reason I remembered which deposits were still owed and which timelines I still needed to build.
testimonials.name: Renata Osei

testimonials.quote: We moved off three spreadsheets and a shared inbox. Now my associate and I see the same pipeline, and nothing falls through when we're both shooting on a Saturday.
testimonials.name: Marcus Dell

testimonials.quote: The contract-plus-deposit link cut my booking time in half. Couples sign and pay before they can second-guess it. That alone paid for the year.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkatesh

pricing.blurb: For the one-person shop running every wedding themselves.
For small teams sharing a pipeline through busy season.
For multi-vendor studios and franchises with many operators.

homepage.footerBlurb: Vowsmith is the earnest CRM for wedding vendors who'd rather be behind the camera than buried in admin. Built for owner-operators, priced per seat.
